newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Geupec started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Geupec started as buy.

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson analyst Enrique Klix said on Tuesday the brokerage began coverage of Mexican bottling company Grupo Embotelladoras Unidas with a buy rating.
"Geupec's growth will be driven by a dramatic increase in earnings from GAM (Mexico's second largest sugar mill) and margin improvement in its core business," he wrote in a report.

Klix said the brokerage forecasts earnings per share growth of 40 percent in 1997 and 17 percent in 1998. He forecasted a six-month target share price of 21.6 pesos, or an upside potential of 37 percent.
He called the bottler, "a sweet bargain," and said Geupec is the healthiest of Mexico's bottlers.
"Geupec is also likely to target a couple of bottlers in Mexico for acquisition or alliance," Klix added.
The company's shares traded unchanged midday at 15.82 pesos.
